name: T.V. Mix
description: A savory and crunchy snack mix featuring pretzels, Chex cereals, nuts, and a blend of seasonings, perfect for munching.
recipeIngredient: 1 pkg pretzel sticks, broken into pieces

recipeInstructions.text: Melt the butter in a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl.
Add the salad oil, Worcestershire sauce, and celery salt to the melted butter and stir to combine.
In a large roasting pan, combine the broken pretzels, Chex cereals, and salted peanuts.
Pour the butter and oil mixture over the cereal and nut mixture, stirring until everything is evenly coated.
Bake in a preheated 200°F oven for 1½ hours, stirring occasionally.
Keep the roasting pan covered during baking, stirring every 15-20 minutes to ensure even toasting.

keywords: snack mix, Chex mix, party snack, savory snack

_similar.name: Mock Cabbage Rolls
_similar.description: A casserole-style dish mimicking cabbage rolls, featuring a savory ground beef and rice mixture layered over shredded cabbage and topped with cheddar cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Brown hamburger with chopped onion, salt, pepper, mushrooms, seasoning salt, onion powder, and garlic salt in a skillet.
Add rice, tomatoes, and soup to the browned hamburger mixture; mix well.
Shred cabbage and place in the bottom of a large casserole dish.
Place the hamburger mixture on top of the cabbage layer.
Cover and bake in a preheated 350°F oven for 30 minutes.
Remove from oven, sprinkle cheddar cheese on top, cover, and return to oven for an additional 15 to 30 minutes, or until cabbage is cooked and cheese is melted.

_similar.keywords: mock cabbage rolls, casserole, cheesy cabbage

_similar.name: Chili Turkey
_similar.description: A hearty chili turkey dish made with ground turkey, kidney beans, and whole wheat spaghetti.

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat. Add onion and cook, stirring occasionally, until it starts to brown, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the turkey and cook, stirring to coarsely crumble until no longer pink, about 8 to 10 minutes.
Stir in chili powder, tomato paste, broth, cinnamon, cumin, salt, coriander, and oregano. Bring to a simmer.
Partially cover and cook, stirring occasionally, until the meat is tender and the broth is slightly thickened.
Meanwhile, pour the beans (with juice) into a microwaveable bowl. Microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated through. Drain and cover to keep warm.
Cook the pasta as directed.
Place pasta on a plate, ladle chili over pasta, and top with beans, then with cheese.

_similar.keywords: chili turkey, ground turkey, kidney beans, whole wheat spaghetti

_similar.name: Meat Balls and Sour And Sweet Sauce
_similar.description: A classic meatball recipe served in a tangy sweet and sour sauce, perfect for serving over meatballs, chicken, or pork chops.
recipeIngredient: 1 tsp onion flakes or 1 tsp real onion

recipeInstructions.text: Mix all ingredients together and form into 1½ inch balls.
Bake in an ungreased oblong pan for 20 to 25 minutes at 400°F.
Remove from oven and drain grease.
Place meatballs in a large casserole.
Pour sweet and sour sauce over the top and return to oven for 10 minutes or until hot.
To make the sauce, mix all ingredients together in a saucepan and stir while bringing to a boil until thickened.

_similar.keywords: meatballs, sweet and sour sauce, baked meatballs

_similar.name: Stir-Fry Chicken
_similar.description: A savory stir-fry dish featuring chicken, vegetables, and a flavorful sauce, served with cheesy buns.
recipeIngredient: Mozzarella cheese and bacon bits for buns

recipeInstructions.text: Heat oil and garlic clove in a pan. Dip bun halves in hot oil, then place on a cookie sheet. Cover with mozzarella cheese and bacon bits. Broil 3 to 4 minutes.
Cube chicken breasts and brown in the pan. Add mushrooms, celery, onion, and Oriental vegetables. Cook thoroughly.
Make a well and add curry powder, soya sauce, Worcestershire sauce, Louisiana hot sauce, and Tabasco. Cook.
Add 1 cup water (or more as needed) to the vegetables. Mix cornstarch with water to thicken the sauce.
Serve the chicken and vegetable mixture over steamed rice with the cheesy buns.
